validationRule.title: GTFS-rt stop_time_update without time doesn't have arrival/departure_time in GTFS
validationRule.errorDescription: If only delay is provided in a stop_time_update arrival or departure (and not a time), then the GTFS stop_times.txt must contain arrival_times and/or departure_times for these corresponding stops.
validationRule.occurrenceSuffix: isn't set and GTFS doesn't have arrival/departure_time in stop_times.txt
